reason: A browser-based Git source control panel for DeepSeek Harness with repository management, staging, commits, synchronization, branch and remote controls, AI commit messages, and commit-history visualization.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供浏览器内的 Git 源代码管理面板，支持暂存、提交、推送、分支与远程仓库管理及提交历史可视化。
summaries.en: A browser-based Git source control panel for DeepSeek Harness supporting staging, commits, pushes, branch and remote management, and commit-history visualization.

capabilities: Creates commits and generates commit messages with an LLM
Pushes, publishes, fetches, and manages branches and remotes
Displays paginated commit history and changed files
Checks for and runs plugin updates
